# Pasquale Caiazzo — llms.txt

Context: Semantic Entity Architecture & Narrative Sovereignty

## Summary
Pasquale Caiazzo is a Semantic Entity Architect based in Turin, Italy. A digital nomad working remotely. His work focuses on Data Sovereignty and Narrative Governance: providing the structural framework for individuals and organizations to control their digital identity within Generative AI ecosystems.
He believes governing one's digital narrative is an act of sovereignty: in a world where AI systems define public perception, deciding what they know about you and how is a fundamental right. Consultant, educator, and trainer in responsible digital innovation.
VAT ID: IT01712990058

## Note (Writing)
Articles on semantic architecture, structured data and narrative sovereignty in AI systems. Author: Pasquale Caiazzo.
- https://pasqualecaiazzo.com/note/ai-search-aziende.html
  "Come far comparire la tua azienda nelle risposte dell'AI" - 2026-06-04. Why clients look for suppliers using AI search, and what it takes for a company to be discovered and cited accurately by answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
- https://pasqualecaiazzo.com/note/omonimia-disambiguazione.html
  "Perché un'AI ti scambia per un altro: omonimia e disambiguazione" - 2026-06-04. Why AI systems confuse people with the same name, the reputational risks, and how semantic entity disambiguation establishes a clear, machine-verifiable identity.
- https://pasqualecaiazzo.com/note/geo-terzo-settore.html
  "GEO per il terzo settore: come un'associazione si fa trovare dall'AI" - 2026-06-03. Why third-sector organizations are nearly invisible to AI systems, and what it takes for their mission and activities to be described and cited accurately.
